title: Multi-Region Cloud Network Gateway
description: Architected a high-availability multi-region hybrid cloud network routing architecture on AWS/Azure, optimizing packet routing, IPSec VPN tunnels, and transit gateways with Terraform infrastructure-as-code.

title: Secure Zero Trust Overlay Network
description: Designed and deployed a WireGuard-based Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) overlay featuring automated ACL policies, micro-segmentation, and key rotation.

title: Automated CI/CD GitOps Pipeline
description: Kubernetes GitOps deployment architecture with ArgoCD, Docker container registry, and Prometheus monitoring on self-hosted servers.

title: SDN Controller & Traffic Shaper
description: Software-Defined Networking controller implementing custom OpenFlow traffic shaping policies to mitigate congestion and handle packet priority queues dynamically.

title: Low-Latency Network Monitor
description: Custom Rust-based low-latency network diagnostic CLI tool for tracking packet loss, round-trip times, and hop counts across WAN routes.

title: Packet Capture & Deep Packet Inspection
description: High-performance Python/C packet capture engine doing deep packet inspection and network threat analysis on live network interfaces.

title: Cloud Portfolio Infrastructure
description: This Next.js portfolio website deployed at scale on serverless edge with sitemaps, robots configurations, optimized Core Web Vitals, and complete structured data.
